title: Fiery Pineapple

items: ½ oz pineapple juice, for floating

steps: Rim a rocks glass with smoked salt. Add lime juice, pineapple-jalapeño syrup, Cointreau and tequila to a shaker with ice.
Shake and strain into the iced glass. Float pineapple juice and garnish with a jalapeño slice.
If the syrup is unavailable, the source says to muddle 2–3 jalapeños and add 1 oz pineapple juice to the recipe.
sourceNote: Adapted from Fork & Fire cocktail recipes.
reviewFlags: The source does not include a recipe for the pineapple-jalapeño syrup.
